metadata.notes: Verified active schemes for 2026. Balanced distribution across Student, Employed, Unemployed, and Retired categories.

schemes.name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
schemes.description: Provides up to 300 units of free electricity monthly via rooftop solar installations with significant setup subsidies.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
schemes.description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion ensuring access to basic savings accounts, credit, insurance, and pension.

schemes.name: PM YASASVI Scholarship Scheme
schemes.description: A top-class education scholarship for OBC, EBC, and DNT students studying in identified schools.

schemes.name: NaMo Drone Didi Scheme
schemes.description: Empowers women SHGs by providing drones and training for agricultural rental services.

schemes.name: Mahila Samman Savings Certificate (MSSC)

schemes.name: Skill India Mission 2.0
schemes.description: Skill development program focusing on new-age skills like AI, Robotics, and Green Energy.

schemes.name: MGNREGA Rural Employment Guarantee
schemes.description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households for unskilled manual work.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana (PMVVY)

schemes.name: National Career Service (NCS)

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)

schemes.name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)

schemes.name: Post Matric Scholarship for SC Students

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)

schemes.name: Khelo India Talent Development Scheme

schemes.name: Atal Vayo Abhyuday Yojana (AVYAY)
